analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 46.7 remains in neutral zone, up from 38.6 five days ago, exiting oversold but consolidating. MACD histogram improved from -29.4315 to -8.6706, still negative. Volume ratio at 1.46 for five consecutive days indicates buying interest. Price is 15.06% above SMA200, showing mid-to-long term uptrend. Positioned at 35.4% of 52-week range. Trading between swing support at $2443.96 and resistance at $2545.62. ADX at 28.4 suggests no clear trend, with -DI (22.8) exceeding +DI (18.2), indicating slight downward pressure. Weekly RSI at 54.9 (neutral), MACD histogram at 61.3198 (bullish). 4H RSI at 59.1 and MACD histogram at 9.5997 show bullish alignment. Buying interest is present, but lack of conviction for a trend reversal warrants a wait-and-see approach.
